title: Dark Mode Design: 5 Tips That Actually Work 🌙
content:
Just finished redesigning this portfolio's dark mode and learned a ton! Here are 5 things that made the biggest visual difference:

**1. Never use pure black (#000)**
Pure black creates harsh contrast. Use deep navy (#060f1e) or dark slate — much easier on the eyes.

**2. Surface hierarchy with subtle lightness steps**
Instead of borders everywhere, use slightly lighter backgrounds for cards and modals. Keep 3-4 surface levels.

**3. Desaturate your colors at night**
Bright saturated colors (#ff0000) are painful in dark mode. Shift to muted variants (#f87171).

**4. Glass morphism for floating elements**
Navbars and tooltips pop beautifully with `backdrop-filter: blur(14px)` + semi-transparent bg.

**5. Test at 10% screen brightness**
Most designers test in bright rooms. That 10% brightness test reveals contrast issues instantly.

title: Supabase vs Firebase in 2026 — My Honest Take ⚖️
content:
After running this portfolio on **Firebase Auth + Supabase DB** for months, here's my honest comparison:

**Supabase wins on:**
- SQL power (joins, RLS, full PostgreSQL)
- Self-hostable (free forever if you need it)
- Realtime subscriptions are actually better
- Open source — no vendor lock-in

**Firebase wins on:**
- Authentication (Google/GitHub OAuth is smoother)
- Realtime DB speed for presence/notifications
- Hosting CDN performance

**My current setup:** Firebase for Auth + Realtime presence, Supabase for everything else. Best of both worlds!
